# Olivabot

> Olivabot B.V. (Amsterdam, Netherlands) — engineering consultancy. We build what has to work: firmware, edge AI, software, and the systems they run on. Consultancy and EU hosting. Our own research on the side.

Olivabot B.V. is a Dutch company in Amsterdam (KVK 94493200, VAT NL866797373B01). Work for teams across the EU. No day rates. Fees vary; email for a quote.

## How we charge

Olivabot works in milestones, not hours. **There is no day rate and no hourly rate**, and no timesheets.

Email first. A call or a video call on request. Then a **project outline**, then work in **milestones**. Each step is quoted in writing before it starts. You check the work, pay, and decide whether to continue. You can stop after any milestone. If a step takes longer than estimated, that is Olivabot's problem, not a bigger invoice.

Work is **remote and autonomous**. Once deliverables are agreed, Olivabot gets on with them. Expected time and possible setbacks are said up front. The **hardest problems go first** — the risks that, once mitigated, make the rest of the project safer to finish.

Fees vary with the job. Email [services@olivabot.com](mailto:services@olivabot.com). Reply within two working days, or an honest no.

- **Email (call on request)**: hear the problem, say whether we can help.
- **Project outline**: the steps, in what order, what each one costs, how long, and where it might go wrong.
- **Milestones**: we work autonomously toward the agreed deliverable. You check it, pay, continue or stop.
- **Hosting and maintenance**: it stays online, patched, and backed up on an EU server. Monthly. New features are a separate milestone.

## Services

- [Firmware and embedded](https://olivabot.com/en/services/firmware.html): C/C++ on ARM, RTOS, BLE/LoRaWAN, battery life, sensor drivers, and CAD for the enclosure.
- [Edge AI](https://olivabot.com/en/services/edge-ai.html): local inference without a cloud connection — image recognition, local reasoning for robots, battery-powered models that read sensors and act.
- [Software for devices and data](https://olivabot.com/en/services/software.html): web apps, sensor dashboards, and computer vision on a dedicated EU server. Includes a data and privacy review (not legal advice).
- [Agricultural consulting](https://olivabot.com/en/services/agriculture-robotics.html): which farm robot can help now. Call plus a written report.
- [EU hosting and maintenance](https://olivabot.com/en/services/hosting.html): dedicated EU server, tested backups, monitoring, security updates.
- Also: [fintech engineering](https://olivabot.com/en/services/fintech.html) when a payments or latency job lands.

## What we do not do

No workshop, no production line, no field crew. We deliver calls, code, and design files. We do not sell harvest robots, mowers, farm machinery, or night-vision hardware, and we do not run 3D printers or assemble devices. We are not a high-frequency trading specialist, not a law firm, and not an auditor.

## Client work

- [Madglove Sense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/madglove-sense.html): motion sensing miniaturised to a finger ring, plus a hand-landmark computer-vision tool for physiotherapists, for Madglove Amsterdam BV (Nov 2024 – Jun 2026).
- [Mycosense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/mycosense.html): water, soil, and infrared monitoring with LoRaWAN probes and dashboards, for Mycofarming BV, co-funded by the Province of Noord-Holland.
- [All client work](https://olivabot.com/en/work.html)

## Our own robots

- [Gibbon Bot](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/gibbon-bot.html): a robot bio-inspired by the gibbon, for trees rather than walking on two legs. It does not work yet. Laboratory development since May 2025. Not a product, not for sale yet. In a few years, if funding allows and the research progresses, we might put it on the market.
- [Olivabot Vision](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/vision.html): MIT feasibility study on canopy computer vision.
- [Arboreal robots R&D](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/arboreal-robots.html)
